# AUB Analysis

## Diagnosis
**Critical: Complete degeneracy** - All 19 folds degenerate with 0% exposure. The baseline is taking zero positions.

This is not a tuning problem—the alpha/execution pipeline is fundamentally broken.

## Root Cause Checklist
| Check | Likely Issue |
|-------|--------------|
| Signal gen | Alpha returning NaN/zero everywhere |
| Universe filter | Over-restrictive, empty tradeable set |
| Entry threshold | Set impossibly high |
| Position sizer | Returning zero size |
| Data feed | Missing/malformed price data |

## Next Commands
```
aub diagnose --lane ost_v62_unified --run unified_baseline --verbose
aub inspect-signals --lane ost_v62_unified --fold 1 --head 50
aub check-universe --lane ost_v62_unified --date-sample 5
```

## Recommended Action
Do **not** proceed with optimization until baseline takes positions. Debug sequence:

1. Verify universe population (`check-universe`)
2. Confirm alpha signals are non-zero (`inspect-signals`)
3. Trace single-date execution path (`diagnose --verbose`)
4. Fix root cause, re-run baseline
5. Confirm `degenerate_folds: []` before handing off to optimization lanes

Most useful next step is to (1) open the run report, (2) run a single-fold backtest with verbose logging to see *why exposure is zero*, and (3) rerun after fixing the gating/clipping issue.

```bash
aub report --lane ost_v62_unified --run unified_baseline
aub backtest --lane ost_v62_unified --run unified_baseline --fold 1 --verbose --dump-signals
aub train --lane ost_v62_unified --base-run unified_baseline --tag fix_exposure --set risk.min_exposure=0.05
```
